otd.apply.ok_console: The new settings are active in OpenTabletDriver (applied with OpenTabletDriver.Console).
otd.apply.ok_rpc: The new settings are active in OpenTabletDriver (sent directly to the daemon).
otd.apply.manual_preset: The settings could not be applied automatically. They were saved as a preset: in OpenTabletDriver open File > Presets and select the preset named in the details, then click Apply.
otd.apply.daemon_not_running: OpenTabletDriver is not running. The settings were saved as a preset: start OpenTabletDriver, open File > Presets and select the preset named in the details.
otd.apply.failed: The settings could not be applied or saved as a preset. See the details.
otd.error.settings_unreadable: Could not read the OpenTabletDriver settings file {path}: {detail}
otd.error.settings_invalid_json: The OpenTabletDriver settings file {path} is damaged (invalid JSON): {detail}
otd.error.settings_not_object: The OpenTabletDriver settings file {path} does not have the expected format.
otd.error.preset_name_invalid: "{name}" cannot be used as a preset name. Avoid the characters < > : " / \ | ? * and a trailing dot.
otd.error.preset_exists: A preset with that name already exists: {path}
otd.notice.old_version: Information: your settings were written by OpenTabletDriver {version}. Version {recommended} or newer is recommended when you use interpolator filters on Windows (0.6.8 keeps aux buttons and touch working with them, 0.6.8.1 fixes a daemon crash of 0.6.8). Updating is your choice; nothing changes if you don't.
